whatsapp.help_text:
🌟 *Instagram Auto-Posting Bot Guide*

This bot helps you prepare photos, videos, and carousels, generate AI captions via Google Gemini / Local LLM, apply stylish filters, overlay custom fonts, configure tags (#) and mentions (@), and publish directly to Instagram!

📸 *Supported Features:*
• *Photos, videos, and albums* (Stories, Feed, Reels, Carousels).
• 🎨 *7 aesthetic filters*: Golden Hour, Vintage, Cinema, B&W Noir, Vibrant, Soft Glow.
• 🔤 *5 decorative fonts*: Modern Sans, Handwriting, Elegant Serif, Retro Rounded, Accent Bold.
• 🤖 *AI Copywriter*: generate engaging captions with hashtags.

🚀 *How to create a post:*
1️⃣ Send a photo or video 📎.
2️⃣ Provide a topic/notes (or send *"done"* for auto-generation).
3️⃣ Review the post and confirm publication!

📋 *Commands:*
• *ping* — test connection (reply: pong)
• */status* — connection & server status
• */help* — help guide
• */tags* — preset hashtags
• */mentions* — constant mentions
• */cancel* — cancel current operation
whatsapp.status_footer: Send a photo, video, or message with a topic to prepare a new post.

🏷️ *Preset Hashtags (#):*

• #family #lifestyle #memories #nature #moments #happiness #photooftheday
• #travel #wanderlust

💡 _Tags are automatically appended to generated captions._
whatsapp.mentions_info:
👥 *Constant Mentions (@):*

• Mentions are used to tag co-authors or family accounts in Instagram.
• Configure the permanent list via the */mentions* command in Telegram bot.

telegram.help_text:
🌟 *Instagram Auto-Posting Bot Guide*

This bot helps you prepare photos, videos, and albums (carousels), generate AI captions in English or Russian, apply designer typography styles, add aesthetic filters (Golden Hour, Vintage, Cinematic, etc.), configure tags (#) and mentions (@), and publish directly to Instagram!

📸 *Supported Features:*
• **Photos, Videos & Albums** (Stories, Feed, Reels, Carousels).
• 🎨 **7 Aesthetic Filters**: Golden Hour, Vintage, Cinematic, B&W Noir, Vibrant, Soft Glow.
• 🔤 **5 Decorative Fonts**: Modern Sans, Handwriting, Elegant Serif, Retro Rounded, Accent Bold.
• 🎙 **Voice Input & Refinement**: dictate instructions or text corrections.

🚀 *How to create a post:*
1️⃣ Send photo, video, or album via 📎.
2️⃣ Choose caption language (🇷🇺 Русский / 🇬🇧 English).
3️⃣ Provide instructions via voice 🎙 or text (or click «Skip»).
4️⃣ Choose post format.
5️⃣ Customize filters, fonts, tags, mentions and publish in 1 click!

📋 *Commands:*
• /start — restart and help guide
• /tags — manage preset hashtags (#)
• /mentions — manage constant mentions (@)
• /status — system & connection status
• /cancel — cancel current operation
